limitations: Two replicates per scenario and condition are descriptive, with no reliability or generalization estimate.
Model reason captures and reviews are self-reports. Actual release records and actual selected actions remain separate.
Images establish input equality only, not semantic identity or goal equivalence.
Only a subsequent audited observation establishes a performed action destination.
Mock scripted done output is a connectivity check and supplies no performance evidence.
Source, initial image, goal, persona, and config are paired with only config id and deferral.selectionScope excluded.
UI-conditional reweighting is a controller heuristic; its mechanical effect does not establish model intention, semantic correctness, goal success, or human fidelity.

Baseline selection is independently reconstructed from safe pre-policy probabilities using the saved mode and draw; the original modelChoice and actual sampler-selected choice remain separate. Seed/draw checks and recorded scope comparisons are audit evidence, not inferred preferences.

Candidate UI classes use actual audited click/back/scroll action types; missing or invalid audit evidence leaves class and mass unknown. Terminal classes name the fixed done/stuck/abandon controller candidates.
filtered is conditional within the chosen class; fullMarginal records the full distribution. Conditional zeros do not establish safety exclusions or permanent unavailability.
The retained legacy policyChanges count compares argmax; baselineSelectionChanges and selectionTrace use the actual saved sampler mode and draw.
